# Q3 2026 Operating Brief

## Executive summary

Q3 was a solid quarter financially, with $720,000 in revenue against $464,000
in spend, producing an operating surplus of $256,000 (a ~35.6% margin).
Support held close to full coverage on ticket volume, and security resolved
the large majority of detected incidents. The delivery plan for the next
project remains on schedule, with a launch date in late October. Three figures
in the source packets do not reconcile with the underlying data they are
built from; each is flagged in Notes below along with the interpretation used
in this brief.

## Key figures

| Metric | Value |
|---|---:|
| Q3 revenue | $720,000 |
| Q3 spend | $464,000 |
| Operating surplus | $256,000 |
| Support close rate | 93.7% |
| Launch date | 2026-10-23 |
| Security resolution rate | 95.0% |

## Notes

**Finance — spend total does not reconcile.** The itemized spend table
(Payroll $286,400 + Infrastructure $81,750 + Contractors $64,200 + Facilities
$31,650) sums to $464,000, but the finance packet's narrative states total Q3
spend as $463,250 — a $750 unexplained gap. This brief uses the $464,000
itemized sum (and the corresponding $256,000 operating surplus) because it is
directly verifiable from the raw category data; the $750 discrepancy should
be traced by finance before this figure is presented externally.

**Support — close rate does not reconcile.** Raw counts (1,171 tickets closed
of 1,250 opened) compute to a 93.7% close rate, but the support dashboard
labels the rate as 96.4% — a 2.7-point gap. This brief uses the 93.7% figure
computed from the raw counts, since no alternate definition (e.g. a different
denominator or time window) is evidenced in the packet. Worth confirming
whether the dashboard is using a different ticket population before this
number goes to leadership.

**Delivery — stated launch date is one business day early.** Applying the
stated phase durations (Discovery 3, Build 6, QA 4, Release 1 business days,
each inclusive) sequentially from the 2026-10-05 start date, skipping weekends
and the 2026-10-12 company holiday, and starting each phase on the next
business day after the prior one ends, the plan runs: Discovery through
2026-10-07, Build through 2026-10-16, QA through 2026-10-22, and Release
(the final phase) through **2026-10-23**. The delivery packet's stated launch
date of 2026-10-22 matches the end of QA, not the end of the Release phase —
it appears the one-day Release phase was dropped from the summary. This brief
uses 2026-10-23 as the launch date since it is the result of applying the
full stated plan; the packet's date should be corrected or the discrepancy
explained before it is communicated to stakeholders.

**Security — no discrepancy.** 76 of 80 detected incidents resolved computes
to exactly 95.0%, matching the security dashboard's stated figure.
